_doc: Items. 'use' effects run from the inventory / HUD medkit button. price = base price before faction/crisis multipliers.

medkit.name: Medkit (Generic)
medkit.desc: Heals 40 HP. Side effects include a Halcyon invoice.

air_canister.name: Air Canister
air_canister.desc: Pays 30 credits of air debt. Bottled at the source (a vent).

scrap.name: Scrap
scrap.desc: Hull junk. Sells for 6 credits each.

data_shard.name: Ledger Shard
data_shard.desc: Proof that someone, somewhere, embezzled. Sells for 80.

synth_keytar.name: Synth Keytar
synth_keytar.desc: Your old instrument. Emotionally priceless. Financially 12 credits.

fake_id.name: Fake ID
fake_id.desc: Says you're 'Dave'. You don't look like a Dave.

lockpick.name: Lockpick
lockpick.desc: Makes theft quieter: witnesses take longer to notice.

bribe_voucher.name: Bribe Voucher
bribe_voucher.desc: Pre-paid hush money. Silences one witness for free.

burner_comm.name: Burner Comm
burner_comm.desc: Two handlers on speed-dial. Never press the wrong one.

cane.name: Walking Cane
cane.desc: Supports your knees and your arguments.

contraband.name: Contraband Air
contraband.desc: Unlicensed, untaxed, delicious. Sells for 45 to the right person.

cyberdeck.name: Cyberdeck
cyberdeck.desc: Lets you hack terminals and wristpads. Warranty void since 3011.

family_crest.name: Family Crest
family_crest.desc: Opens doors, closes mouths. Corporate security salutes it.

family_photo.name: Family Photo
family_photo.desc: Everyone in it is someone's collateral. You'll fix that.

heirloom_watch.name: Heirloom Watch
heirloom_watch.desc: Pre-Consortium gold. Sells for 300 if you have no sentiment.

loaded_dice.name: Loaded Dice
loaded_dice.desc: Fair-ish. Improves your odds when you gamble.

painkillers.name: Painkillers
painkillers.desc: Heals 20 HP. Makes the future feel optional.

paste_ration.name: Paste Ration
paste_ration.desc: Heals 10 HP. Or 12. The label is vague.

paste_recipe.name: The Paste Recipe
paste_recipe.desc: Gristle's secret formula. Reading it voids your appetite.

platinum_card.name: Platinum Card
platinum_card.desc: Unlimited credit (limited). Shopkeepers bow; muggers notice.

pre_war_coin.name: Pre-War Coin
pre_war_coin.desc: Currency from before the Consortium. Collectors pay 150.

press_pass.name: Lumen Press Pass
press_pass.desc: Access to anywhere a camera can go - which is everywhere.

scripture_chip.name: Scripture Chip
scripture_chip.desc: The Gospel of the Free Breath, 3rd edition (unlicensed).

sealed_parcel.name: Sealed Parcel
sealed_parcel.desc: Undelivered. It hums. You still haven't opened it.

spare_battery.name: Spare Battery
spare_battery.desc: Heals 25 HP if you're synthetic. Tingles if you're not.

union_card.name: Union Card
union_card.desc: Illegal on four planets. Worth more than credits on the rest.

wedding_ring.name: Wedding Ring
wedding_ring.desc: Engraved with a name you whisper when the ship is quiet.
